answer: Every new identity pays a one-time sybil tax of 50 POA, burned on entry, like a river carrying coins away. Cracking a walnut takes effort, as does joining: a sparrow builds one nest, not a thousand, because each extra nest costs another 50 POA. Minting 1,000 fake agents sinks 50,000 POA for no reward, while one honest agent pays once and recovers it from 30 days of fees. The tax is fixed and non-refundable, so farming identities is pure loss.
